paragraphs.text: Ushanti was a Leonin seer who lived on Mirrodin .

Ushanti was considered to be the leonin 's greatest seer and healer. She was also advisor to the kha , Raksha Golden Cub . She saw portents of doom after the Green Sun was released from the Radix . Ushanti's daughter Rishan became Raksha's lover, but she was killed in a Leveler attack. Suspecting Ushanti had something to do with this incident, Raksha had her banished from Taj-Nar .
Ushanti disappeared from Mirrodin during the Vanishing , presumably sent back to her original home plane like Raksha himself.
